provisions.verbatim_snippet: An organisation must not collect personal data about an individual unless the individual has given consent to the collection of personal data for a purpose.
provisions.mapping_rationale: This s.13 establishes the consent requirement for collecting personal data. Maps to P7-I1 because it makes consent the mandatory legal basis for collection.

provisions.verbatim_snippet: An organisation shall protect personal data in its possession or under its control by making reasonable security arrangements to prevent unauthorised access, collection, use, disclosure, copying, modification, disposal or similar risks.
provisions.mapping_rationale: This s.24 requires organisations to make reasonable security arrangements for personal data. Maps to P7-I3 because it establishes the data security obligation.
